description: fz-go4.19's duplication inventory (2026-07-03, at bcc1ac3d0) found a THIRD near-verbatim copy of the product pull-drive loop as test scaffolding in src/compiler2/transport_contract_test.rs — drive_root_backend_product_for_test / pull_product_until_produced_with_fact_waits / drive_product_fact_wait_for_test / product_fact_wait_is_satisfied_for_test (~lines 4558-4644 at that commit; panic-based instead of Result-based). Production copies were unified into compiler2::product_drive (ProductDriveError trait, fz-go4.19); evaluate whether the test scaffold can consume the shared runner via a panic-based ProductDriveError impl instead of keeping a fork. (The by-cover selection idiom duplication originally also tracked here was extracted at the fz-go4.18.28.15 fold — two_executables_covered_by_one_solve — and is no longer part of this ticket.) Test-only, two-lane audit.

comments.text: FOLDED as ecccd0efb. Anti-drift dedup: the fork's INNER fact-wait loop (drive_product_fact_wait_for_test + product_fact_wait_is_satisfied_for_test, ~66 lines re-implementing production's job-running/budget/satisfied logic) is DELETED; the 2 RootBackendProduct call sites now use product_drive::drive_root_backend_product::<PanicProductDriveError>, and the remaining fact-wait expansions use the shared product_drive::drive_product_fact_wait (bumped private->pub(super), visibility-only). FINDING (reshapes ticket premise): the fork was NOT purely a RootBackendProduct copy -- 7 of 9 sites drive arbitrary ProductKeys (TransportShape/RuntimeDemand/MaterializedExecutable) production has no runner for, so the outer generic-key stack stays local (legitimately distinct capability, not dead duplication); only its inner loop was the true fork. Verified equivalence: PRODUCT_DRIVE_BUDGET==50_000 (== old hardcoded), zero panic-text assertions so the lost per-call-site messages change no outcome, module 73/0, lib 1197/0/9. Also dropped a now-dead tel param from 8 call sites. Single-lane audit self-covered (full diff read + equivalence checks). Test-only.

title: Dedup transport_contract_test.rs scaffolding: third drive-loop copy + by-cover selection idiom
